name: Saheeli, Radiant Creator
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast an Artificer or artifact spell, you get {E} (an energy counter).
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {E}{E}{E}. When you do, create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {E}{E}{E}. When you do, create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

needs.what: copy_permanent's `except_` honouring `add_keywords` (707.9b): "create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control, except it's a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types and has haste" writes haste into the token's copiable values beside power/toughness 5 and add_types [Artifact, Creature], so the token has haste as part of what it is and any later copy of it also has haste
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ is checked against loader.effects.COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (colors, types, power, toughness, add_types, add_subtypes, add_supertypes, remove_supertypes, no_mana_cost), so add_keywords is refused at load, and characteristics._compute never reads keywords from copy_overrides. become_copy's except_ accepts add_keywords but turns an existing permanent into a copy and creates no token. A following grant_keyword with duration permanent on the `as` binding is a granted layer-6 effect, not a copiable value (a copy of the token would lack haste) -- the same reason Twinflame was filed. The rest is expressible: spell_cast trigger with an any_of filter (subtypes Artificer / types Artifact) and add_energy; begin_combat trigger on your turn, may with pay {pay_energy: 3} and a reflexive_trigger targeting a permanent you control; copy_permanent with except_ {power: 5, toughness: 5, add_types: [Artifact, Creature]} and `as`; a delay at end_step sacrificing the binding.
